simple.summary: חֶרְמֵשׁ (chermêsh) means a sickle (as cutting) First listed occurrence: Deut 16 9.

definitions.full: H2770. chermesh חֶרְמֵשׁ noun [masculine] sickle (on form see Ges § 85 xii. 55) — Deut 16:9 ; Deuteronomy 23:26.
